review_description: Trent did an outstanding job.Sales and quoting was super easy, Trent came on site and provided quotes shortly after. He provided his direct number and we were able to discuss alternate quotes which he sent out quick.Installation was spot on. He was able to get us in before Christmas and finished the majority of the work swiftly. He went out of his way to fix up some broken tiles on the roof and replaced with spares we had.He always kept us updated and provided photos as we weren't at the property during the entire process. He organised everything needed for the connection and gave information on how everything is setup and how it operates.Trent did an amazing job across the board and would recommend him to anyone.

Trent gave a clear, thorough, and thoughtful quote and negotiated transparently on price.He was excellent to work with, considerate of our needs and did a great job of installing our system, in a timely fashion. Trent made the whole process very straight forward.
